// c3b: deadlock inverse. main blocks on a channel nobody sends to, while a pending timer's goroutine wakes and then
// blocks on a send nobody receives. The timer cannot unblock main, so once it has fired every goroutine is asleep.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int)
	other := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
		other <- 1 // nobody receives
	}()
	fmt.Println("blocking")
	<-ch
}
